database.signature: public.account_terms_current_v1() RETURNS TABLE (manifest_sha256 bytea, revision bigint)
database.rationale: These are the only two values required by current metadata. Existing head composite FK already binds the receipt/revision/digest tuple. Do not add future enrollment locking/acceptance behavior to this reader.
database.body_shape: SQL STABLE SECURITY DEFINER; fixed search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp; SELECT h.manifest_sha256,h.revision FROM public.account_terms_head AS h WHERE h.id=1. Return zero/one rows; no caller arguments, locks or mutations.
database.acl: Only required owner SELECT(id,manifest_sha256,revision) on account_terms_head; revoke PUBLIC and business execution; grant EXECUTE only to console_auth_rt. Auth gets no table SELECT. Exact function definition and grant profile must be enrolled in existing custody readback.
database.not_frozen: Internal API proposal only. Public acceptance tests do not depend on this function name or implementation shape.
